digest.component_or_area: plan review criteria vocabulary and enforcement
propositions: Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria headings carry identical semantic weight across all criteria gates and should be unified into a single vocabulary
The _count_ac_items detector counts only checkboxes under ## Acceptance Criteria, causing criteria under ## Success Criteria to bypass completion verification and operator attestation
106 store tickets must be migrated from ## Success Criteria bullets to ## Acceptance Criteria checkboxes to enforce consistent detection and verification
Criteria registry references, reviewer prompts, detector regexes, author guides, and generated documentation must be updated to use only ## Acceptance Criteria across rebar
Three permanent content exclusions (plan_review_T2.md, plan_review_verifier.md/agentic, verify_models.py dod_uncertifiable wording) must survive the collapse as deferred separate concepts
